item.title: Fuego Latino: A Journey Through Latin Soul, Jazz & Rhythm
item.description:
From the Afro-Cuban jazz pioneers of 1940s Harlem to the Buena Vista Social Club's Havana revival, this show traces the pulse of Latin music through three explosive decades. Featuring Machito, Cal Tjader, Eddie Palmieri, Willie Bobo, Pucho, Bobby Paunetto, Joe Bataan, Jorge Ben, Tito Puente, and the Buena Vista Social Club.

Series: latin-jazz-corner

Tags: boogaloo, mambo, brazilian, afro-cuban, latin soul, salsa, latin jazz

item.title: Desert Sessions Vol. 2: Generator Parties
item.description:
A journey through the sun-baked, fuzz-drenched world of desert rock — from the illegal generator parties of Palm Desert to the modern psychedelic revival. This episode explores the origins of the genre, the breakthrough of Songs for the Deaf, and Josh Homme's resurrection after his near-death experience.
